content:
Thanks to @mario1973p for reminding me about this Chinese space carrier that looks like it's from Star Wars. I didn't want to report on this because this technology is still conventional and can be easily suppressed by peer enemy/adversary. #ufotwitter #ufoX #China

This concept was unveiled by Chinese state media for a futuristic "space carrier" called Luanniao (possibly translating to something like "Raging Bird" or similar).

China reportedly released a concept video showing this massive aircraft carrier-like vehicle operating at the edge of the atmosphere.

It would deploy unmanned fighter jets, launch missiles from space, zip through the upper atmosphere, and supposedly evade all existing air defense systems.

It's hyped as potentially the world's largest "aircraft carrier" — but in space/near-space rather than sea-based.
